decisions.statement: A manifest is read from its own text and nothing else.
A manifest that will not parse names no way in.
A manifest calling its package nothing names no way in.
The name a manifest calls its package is answered apart from the ways in.
A body that is not there calls its package nothing.
A target that is no string names no way in.
A target is resolved against the folder the manifest sits in.
A key is reached by the package's name followed by that key past its opening dot.
A key that is a lone dot names the package itself.
A manifest stating one string for its exports is read as stating a lone dot.
A key that is not a lone dot and opens with no dot names no way in.
A specifier two manifests both name lands where the first of those manifests says.
Nothing here reads the disk or the index.
Whether the file a way in names is there is not judged here.

definition: the name a package is reached by and the file each way in lands on
